title: Grateful Dead Live at Aqua Theater on 1969-08-21
source: S:Cm,C,D,CDR [Soundboard -> Bear's Cassette master -> Cassette -> DAT -> CD]

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a mellow Seattle show featuring a brief Dark Star and a rare flute cameo on China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source with clear, decent audio quality, though the performance itself is described as mellow and unusually short – the six‑minute Dark Star being a particular oddity. A guest flautist (often credited as Charles Lloyd but likely Gary Larkey) adds an interesting texture to China Cat Sunflower, making that moment the main highlight of an otherwise low‑energy set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated around average (mellow, not a 'keeper') while recording quality is noted as good; the weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound quality is good and clear; no major issues such as dropouts or muddiness are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, mellow set with a notably brief Dark Star and a rare flute‑enhanced China Cat Sunflower; overall pacing is low‑energy.
